parameters.query:
select
  c.id            as clarification_id,
  c.will_id       as will_id,
  c.message_final as message_final,
  l.full_name     as full_name,
  l.email         as email
from clarifications c
join wills w on w.id = c.will_id
join leads l on l.id = w.lead_id
where c.status = 'sent'
  and c.notified_at is null
order by c.sent_at
limit 50;

nodes.name: Select pending clarifications
nodes.notes: SELECT returns one item per pending clarification (email, name, message, will_id). 0 rows -> run ends, no email. Keep 'Always Output Data' OFF (Settings tab) so an empty poll doesn't push a blank item downstream.

parameters.subject: =Your lawyer has a question about your will, {{ $json.full_name.split(' ')[0] }}
parameters.html:
=

Hi {{ $json.full_name.split(' ')[0] }},

{{ $json.message_final }}

Reply to your lawyer →

Thank you,
The InstaWill team

nodes.name: Send clarification email
nodes.notes: message_final is the lawyer-approved, LLM-drafted question — sent verbatim. Set APP_URL in n8n Settings -> Variables. Swap the SMTP node for Resend/SendGrid if you prefer.

parameters.query: update clarifications set notified_at = now() where id = '{{ $('Select pending clarifications').item.json.clarification_id }}' and notified_at is null;

nodes.name: Mark notified
nodes.notes: Runs only after the email sends (send-then-mark), so an SMTP failure leaves the row un-notified and it retries next minute. Uses the paired SELECT item for the id, since the email node doesn't pass the row through.
